subject.title: feat(android): add Wear real-time Talk controls

question: Should Wear Real-Time Talk remain an additive v1 capability that may fail gracefully against an older paired phone, or must the watch hide/disable it until the phone advertises explicit Talk support?
rationale: The repository's versioned Wear contract and independently updated phone/watch apps make upgrade behavior a product compatibility choice; source inspection cannot determine the intended mixed-version promise.

options.title: Add capability negotiation
options.body: Advertise realtime Talk support separately and expose the watch control only when the selected phone confirms support.

options.title: Accept additive v1 behavior
options.body: Keep the existing capability identifiers but add explicit old-phone/new-watch and new-phone/old-watch proof showing a clear, recoverable unsupported state.

recommendation.title: Add capability negotiation
recommendation.body: Advertise realtime Talk support separately and expose the watch control only when the selected phone confirms support.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the Wear v1 contract and authored the latest routing-hardening commit, making them the best available owner for its compatibility policy.
